item.title: AlexNet from scratch
item.description: Implemented AlexNet from scratch using just the research paper as source. The notes discuss the fundamental concepts of CNN and showcase various problems Ifaced while coding the Alexnet architecture.

item.title: GPT from scratch
item.description: This is a very rustic blog post about the foundational aspect of building a GPT model from the ground up. The article covers essential topics such as tokenization, data chunking, batch processing, and the implementation of a Bigram language model using PyTorch.
